Description: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 09 The Team: The Biofuels Research and Analytics division of S&P Global Energy Horizons provides ‘well to wheels’ coverage of the global biofuels market, providing fundamental insights and developing views on the emerging trends that will drive the long-term development of biofuels. The team is responsible for generating long-term forecasts of biofuels supply and demand, as well as the future value and margins of biofuels.
